rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something very bad or unpleasant, especially something of poor quality.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is terrible.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 caa1

rows.note: Choose this for an extreme or severe degree, especially serious consequences or a heavy price.

example.english: His injuries are terrible, and he may need surgery.
example.traditional: 佢傷勢嚴重，可能要做手術。
example.jyutping: keoi5 soeng1 sai3 jim4 zung6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6

rows.note: Choose this when something causes fear or feels terrifying, rather than merely being bad.

example.english: The ghost in that movie was terrible—it scared me to death.
example.traditional: 嗰套戲入面個鬼樣真係好恐怖，嚇到我死。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go3 gwai2 joeng6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hung2 bou3 haak3 dou3 ngo5 sei2

rows.note: Choose this for someone or something formidable or impressively powerful.

example.english: That boxer is terrible—no one can beat him.
example.traditional: 嗰個拳手真係好厲害，冇人打得贏佢。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 kyun4 sau2 zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hoi6 mou5 jan4 daa2 dak1 jeng4 keoi5
